home.title: Our Exhibits
home.hint: Tap an exhibit to learn more

exhibits.title: The Deep Ocean
exhibits.body: Most of the ocean gets no sunlight. Animals here make their own light, live under huge pressure, and can go months without food.

exhibits.title: Volcanoes
exhibits.summary: How the Earth lets off steam.
exhibits.body: A volcano forms where hot rock from deep inside the Earth breaks through the crust. Some erupt every day. Others sleep for thousands of years.

exhibits.title: The Solar System
exhibits.body: The Sun holds 99.8% of the mass in our solar system. Jupiter is so big that all the other planets could fit inside it.

exhibits.title: Dinosaurs
exhibits.body: Dinosaurs lived for about 165 million years. Birds are their living relatives, so in a way dinosaurs never fully went away.
